title: Specify lead reconciliation envelope
description: Validates the request and response envelopes of the agent-led lead-reconciliation step per RFC-29 §Lead reconciliation engine (D2). Discriminated by closed `kind`. `kind: request` is returned by `specrun plan propose --dry-run --format json`: a pure function of the parsed `discovery.md` carrying the full lead inventory and the deterministic structural floor (exact id / exact alias / transitive cross-reference), handed to the agent so it never re-derives trivial matches. `kind: response` is the agent's grouping consumed by `specrun plan propose --from`: each group declares its `(source-key, lead-id)` members with a per-member `match-basis` (including agent-only `semantic` matches), a single bound `target` per group (one slice per `(group, target)` pair, per D5), optional `depends-on`, optional per-group `rationale`, and optional per-member `tentative` flag for operator review at Gate 1. The kernel validates this shape, enforces the lead-partition and structural-floor invariants, assigns/validates group ids, and writes through the existing plan writers; it never auto-merges on its own heuristic. Closed top-level shape — unknown fields are rejected.

matchBasis.description: How a member joined its group. `exact-id` / `exact-alias` / `cross-reference` are the deterministic structural floor the kernel computes; `semantic` is the agent's cross-source judgment and is surfaced for operator review.

group-id.description: Canonical id the floor group is recorded under (the shared `id` for exact-id / cross-reference, the canonical id behind an alias for exact-alias).

lead-inventory.description: Map of source-key to that source's surveyed lead ids.

structural-floor.description: Deterministic exact-id / exact-alias / cross-reference groups the kernel pre-computed. The agent may extend a floor group with semantic members but the kernel refuses any response that splits one.

ungrouped.description: Leads that matched nothing on the structural floor — the agent's semantic-matching surface.

tentative.description: Agent-flagged low-confidence membership; surfaced for operator review at Gate 1.

group-id.description: Proposed slice name. Validated against the slice-name grammar by the kernel; the agent proposes it, the kernel does not invent it.

target.description: Exactly one target per group (one slice per (group, target) pair, per D5). The same lead group may appear under more than one target.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for the grouping; rendered into change.md for operator review, most useful on semantic merges.
